description: [Egypt] Electric Vehicles Charging Stations is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. This dataset represents the geographic distribution of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations in Egypt. Locations and attributes were observed and compiled from the PlugShare platform, which aggregates user-reported information on charging infrastructure. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Cairo, Egypt, Electric, Greater Cairo Region. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
